name: Armagetron Advanced
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The 3D light-cycle racing game: trap the other players behind your wall. Runs the dedicated server, with its console for commands and your own settings in settings/autoexec.cfg.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Armagetron Advanced. Installs the dedicated server from Debian 13's
# armagetronad-dedicated package (Armagetron publishes Linux servers only
# for x86), checked against Debian's signed package list, for this node's
# CPU. Your settings (settings/autoexec.cfg), and the logs, ladder and
# scores in var/ are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/root"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

# Debian 13's packages, checked against Debian's signed package list.
debian_index() { # <cpu>: Debian's list of packages for that CPU (amd64, arm64)
    local f="main/binary-$1/Packages.xz" sum
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/InRelease" https://deb.debian.org/debian/dists/trixie/InRelease ||
        fail "Debian's archive can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    gpgv --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg --output "$build/Release" "$build/InRelease" 2>/dev/null ||
        fail "Debian's package list isn't signed by Debian. Reinstall to try again."
    sum=$(awk -v f="$f" 'length($1) == 64 && $3 == f { print $1 }' "$build/Release")
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/Packages.xz" "https://deb.debian.org/debian/dists/trixie/$f" ||
        fail "Debian's archive can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    [ -n "$sum" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$build/Packages.xz" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] ||
        fail "Debian's package list didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    xz -d "$build/Packages.xz"
}
debian_version() { # <package>: its version in the list
    awk -v p="$1" '/^Package: / { n = $2 } n == p && /^Version: / { print $2; exit }' "$build/Packages"
}
debian_unpack() { # <package>...: downloads each, checks it, and unpacks it into $build/root
    local p file sum
    for p in "$@"; do
        read -r file sum < <(awk -v p="$p" '/^Package: / { n = $2 } n == p && /^Filename: / { f = $2 } n == p && /^SHA256: / { s = $2 }
            /^$/ { if (n == p && f != "") { print f, s; exit } n = "" }' "$build/Packages") || true
        [ -n "${file:-}" ] || fail "Debian has no package $p for this CPU."
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/$p.deb" "https://deb.debian.org/debian/$file" ||
            fail "The download of $p from Debian failed. Reinstall to try again."
        [ "$(sha256sum "$build/$p.deb" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "$p from Debian didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        dpkg-deb -x "$build/$p.deb" "$build/root"
    done
}

cpu=$(dpkg --print-architecture)
debian_index "$cpu"
version="$(debian_version armagetronad-dedicated) $(debian_version libxml2)"
v=${version%%-*}
if [ -x games/armagetronad-dedicated ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "Armagetron Advanced $v is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Armagetron Advanced $v from Debian"
    debian_unpack armagetronad-dedicated armagetronad-common libxml2
    r="$build/root"
    mkdir -p lib
    cp -a "$r"/usr/lib/*-linux-gnu/libxml2.so.2* lib/
    # The game's own data and default settings, replaced on every update.
    rm -rf data config
    mv "$r/usr/share/games/armagetronad" data
    cp -aL "$r/etc/armagetronad" config
    # In games/, where it expects to be (it works out its folders from there).
    mkdir -p games
    mv -f "$r/usr/games/armagetronad-dedicated.real" games/armagetronad-dedicated
    echo "$version" > .raptor-version
fi

mkdir -p settings var
# The lines the Panel sets from the server's variables at every start.
cat > settings/server_info.cfg <<'CFG'
# Set from the server's variables at every start: change them in the Panel.
SERVER_PORT 4534
SERVER_NAME Armagetron Advanced server
MAX_CLIENTS 16
TALK_TO_MASTER 1
CFG
if [ ! -f settings/autoexec.cfg ]; then
    cat > settings/autoexec.cfg <<'CFG'
# Your settings, read after the game's defaults (config/settings.cfg and
# config/settings_dedicated.cfg list them all). One setting per line, such
# as:
# CYCLE_SPEED 30
# MESSAGE_OF_DAY Welcome!
CFG
fi
echo "Installed Armagetron Advanced $v."
